heading: The Kerala (Alteration of Name) Act, 2026
body_html:
(1) This Act may be called the Kerala (Alteration of Name) Act, 2026.

(2) It shall come into force on such date1 as the Central Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, appoint.
footnote_html: 1. 25th day of August, 2026, vide Notifn. No. S.O. 4712 (E), dated 25th August, 2026, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, s. 3 (ii)
